info.name: Retrieves message history for the specified profile.  Messages retrieved from the date spacified (default now), in descending time order.

params.name: channelId
params.description: The id of the channel the message was sent or received on

params.name: from
params.description: The date (in UTC, ISO 8601 format) to query backwards from

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return
